name: Twisting the Knife
summary: Marek asks you to hunt Daggerfang, the crocolisk that took his knife. The beast prowls along the lake’s edge, where other hunters may be at risk.

sections.title: Marek’s Knife
sections.body: Marek tells you that a crocolisk nearly took his hand and left him scrambling from the lake. He thinks his knife is still somewhere nearby. He calls the beast Daggerfang and asks you to find it along the lake’s edge, where other hunters may be in danger.

faq.answer: Daggerfang is a crocolisk Marek says hunts along the edge of the lake.
Marek thinks he left his knife near the lake after using it against a crocolisk.

faq.q: Why does Marek want Daggerfang hunted?
faq.answer: Marek believes Daggerfang may threaten the other hunters near the lake.
Marek says Daggerfang hunts along the edge of the lake.

faq.q: What does Marek ask me to bring back?
faq.answer: Marek asks you to find and defeat Daggerfang and bring back his knife.

faq.q: What does Marek say about the crocolisk?
faq.answer: Marek says the crocolisk nearly took his hand, and he used his knife against it to escape.
